purpose: Review post-calling quality metrics and call-level plausibility.
interpretive_boundary: Technical outputs are pipeline and parameter dependent.

purpose: Apply transparent, documented post-calling filters and normalization as appropriate.
Establish genome build, gene, transcript, and consequence context.
interpretive_boundary: Transcript selection and release differences can alter interpretation.

purpose: Assess whether observed frequency is compatible with the disease model.
interpretive_boundary: Rarity alone does not establish pathogenicity.

purpose: Use structured phenotype information to prioritize candidate genes and variants.
representative_resources: HPO; Exomiser; LIRICAL; Phen2Gene; MSeqDR-QM; GEMSTONE
interpretive_boundary: Prioritization is not proof of causality.

purpose: Assess clinical relevance and strength of the gene–disease relationship.
Use applicable computational, regulatory, structural, and protein-function context.
representative_resources: CADD; REVEL; SIFT; PolyPhen-2; AlphaMissense; GTEx; ENCODE; RegulomeDB; FANTOM5; UniProt; PDB; AlphaFold DB; InterPro
interpretive_boundary: Predictions and annotations are supportive, not autonomous clinical evidence.

purpose: Assess potential splice-altering effects with transcript-aware methods and complementary evidence.
interpretive_boundary: Predicted splice effects require contextual and, where possible, experimental corroboration.

stage_name: Functional, clinical, and literature evidence integration
purpose: Integrate regulatory, structural, functional, clinical, and literature-derived evidence.
representative_resources: GTEx; ENCODE; RegulomeDB; FANTOM5; UniProt; PDB; AlphaFold DB; InterPro; ClinVar; ClinGen; HGMD; Mastermind; PubMed; MSeqDR-QM; GEMSTONE
interpretive_boundary: Assess provenance, quality, relevance, and dependence among evidence sources.

purpose: Apply ACMG/AMP criteria and applicable ClinGen specifications with expert review.
representative_resources: ACMG/AMP guidelines; ClinGen specifications; InterVar; VarSome; Franklin
interpretive_boundary: Automated support tools do not replace contextual expert classification.

purpose: Document versions, evidence, decisions, limitations, and triggers for reassessment.
interpretive_boundary: Evidence and interpretations may change over time.
